name: Kungfu2
detailed_description:
This is a fast-paced survivor game. Players will play as kungfus with special skills, and challenge 30 levels in a 30-second violent battle. Each character has its own characteristics, and with a variety of kungfus and props, activate the power of bondage and challenge the final BOSS!

Each level is only 30 seconds, and ordinary levels quickly kill enemies to accumulate resources, and boss levels!

Multiple character kungfus characteristics

Sword Immortal, God of Wealth, Scholar... Each character has its own characteristics. Switch characters, explore completely different fighting styles, and find your destiny kungfus!

Bond kungfus system

After each level, choose randomly refreshed kungfus and props, activate dozens of bond effects, and each game is a unique growth path!

Sword system + Kongtong School = Blade of Fire!

Sword system + Fist system = High attack speed + True damage = Meat shield nemesis!

The more you fight, the stronger you become, and the more you grow

Killing monsters will drop gold coins and experience, and strengthen your attack, attack speed, critical strike and other attributes in real time! The difficulty of the levels rises step by step. Can your construction defeat the final boss?

Gameplay highlights

Short, flat and fast game: 15 minutes to complete a single game, and you can complete it in a few minutes when you turn on the double speed!

Strategic depth: The kungfus fetters require delicate calculations. Is it mindless shopping? Or operating the economy? In "Kungfu2", every decision is a gamble to live and die.

—— Today, can you rewrite the limits of kungfus within 30 seconds? ——
